title: Software should be
fast, private, and built to last.
lede: FoxTerm is a native terminal client for macOS and iOS. No Electron, no web wrappers, no telemetry — just Swift and C doing exactly what they were designed to do.

label: 01 / WHY FOXTERM
title: The tools weren't good enough. So I wrote one.
body: SSH is the interface infrastructure runs on. It's where late-night deploys happen, where servers get debugged, where things get fixed. Every client I tried either felt stuck in 2004 or charged a subscription for features that should be native.

FoxTerm started as a personal tool — a terminal client that actually respects the macOS and iOS design language, runs on native frameworks, and doesn't phone home. It turned into something worth sharing.
No telemetry. No accounts. No feature gates hiding behind paywalls. Just a tool that does the job and gets out of your way.

label: 02 / ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES
title: What FoxTerm is built on — and what it will never compromise.
body: Swift and C — not Electron, not a web wrapper. FoxTerm talks directly to AppKit and UIKit, so it feels like it was born on your Mac and iPhone, not ported from a browser tab.
Zero telemetry. Connection data, keys, and session history never leave the device. Keys live in the Secure Enclave when available — not on a cloud server somewhere.
Cold launch under 400 ms. Terminal rendering at native frame rates. No JavaScript engine overhead, no startup splash screens, no artificial delays.
Free to download with all features included. Pro removes the node limit — via App Store subscription or a one-time activation code. No locked-out essentials, no artificial tiers.

title: Our Commitment: Zero Telemetry
body: FoxTerm is built on the principle that your server infrastructure, credentials, and workflows belong exclusively to you. We operate under a strict
and do not collect, transmit, or store any of your operational data on external servers.
zero-telemetry policy

title: 1. Data We Collect
body: FoxTerm collects absolutely no telemetry data. Specifically:
items: No analytics, usage tracking, or behavior monitoring
No crash reports sent to third-party servers by default
No connection logs, command history, or session metadata
No IP addresses, hostnames, or server fingerprints transmitted
No SSH keys, passwords, or authentication credentials ever leave your device

title: 2. Local Data Storage & Encryption
body: All sensitive data is stored exclusively on your device using Apple's native security frameworks:
items: SSH private keys are encrypted and protected by your device's Secure Enclave hardware when available
Secure Enclave Protection:
Credentials and passwords are stored in your local iCloud Keychain, encrypted with Apple's hardware encryption
Keychain Isolation:
Connection profiles and settings are stored locally on your device; iCloud sync occurs only through your private iCloud Container, encrypted end-to-end by Apple
Local Configuration:

title: 3. Network Communications
body: FoxTerm establishes direct peer-to-peer connections exclusively to servers that you explicitly configure:
items: All connections (SSH, VNC, SFTP, Docker/Podman) go directly from your device to your servers
We do not operate proxy servers, relays, or intermediary services for your traffic
App Store transactions are processed entirely by Apple; we do not receive or store payment information
No third-party analytics SDKs are embedded in the application

title: 4. iCloud Sync
body: When you enable iCloud configuration sync:
items: Synced data is stored exclusively in your personal iCloud account, not on our servers
Sync transport is managed and encrypted entirely by Apple's CloudKit infrastructure
Private keys are
synced via iCloud; they remain isolated to each device's Secure Enclave
never
You may disable iCloud sync at any time through app settings or system iCloud preferences

title: 5. App Store Receipt Validation
body: For Pro subscription status verification, FoxTerm may communicate with Apple's App Store servers to validate your subscription entitlement. This communication:
items: Is handled through standard Apple StoreKit APIs
Contains only your Apple transaction receipt identifiers
Does not include any of your server data, credentials, or usage information
Is processed directly between your device and Apple; FoxTerm backend servers do not log or store these requests

title: 6. Third-Party Services
body: FoxTerm does not integrate with any third-party analytics, advertising, or data collection services. The only external services interacted with are:
items: Apple App Store and CloudKit services (governed by Apple's Privacy Policy)
SSH, VNC, SFTP, Docker/Podman servers that you explicitly configure and connect to directly

body: FoxTerm does not knowingly collect any personal information from children under the age of 13 (or applicable age in your jurisdiction). The app is a professional developer tool designed for use by technical professionals.
